questions.q_en: In a family, the number of female members is more than the number of male members. Chanda has only two children. Akash is the husband of Bimal, who is a mother of Chanda. Chanda is the only sister of Nihar and Mihir. Bijal is only child of Mihir. Dishul is a father of Esha. Among the children of Akash, only one is unmarried. Nihar is the uncle of Esha, who is the sister of Emu. Then Emu is _____ of Chanda and _____ of Nihar.
questions.solution_en:
Akash is the husband of Bimal, who is a mother of Chanda. Chanda is the only sister of Nihar and Mihir. Bijal is only child of Mihir.

Chanda has only two children. Among the children of Akash, only one is unmarried. Nihar is the uncle of Esha, who is the sister of Emu. Dishul is a father of Esha.

The number of female members is more than the number of male members.

Therefore, Emu and Bijal are females.

Then Emu is daughter of Chanda and niece of Nihar.

questions.q_en: What is the measure of the smaller of the two angles formed between the hour hand and the minute hand of a clock when it is 6:51 p.m.?
questions.solution_en:
Formula to calculate angle(N) between minutes hand and Hour hand is:

N = {(11/2)xM} - 30 x H

N= {(11/2)x51} - 30 x 6

N= 280.5 - 180

N = 100.5

So, the measure of the smaller of the two angles formed between the hour hand and the minute hand of a clock when it is 6:51 p.m is 100.5⁰.

Courses of action:

I. The Finance Ministry must institute an enquiry into the complaints received regarding delay in income tax refunds.

II: The Finance Ministry must compensate the income tax payees by paying interest on their refunds for the duration of the delay.
questions.solution_en:
Course of Action I logically follows as it addresses the root issue - delay in refunds - by suggesting an enquiry to understand and resolve the problem. Course of Action II, though fair in principle, assumes compensation without first identifying the cause or accountability.

Select the option that represents the correct order of the given words as they would appear in an English dictionary.

1- Absurdly

2- Abstriction

3- Abstract

4- Absolutely

5- Abstain

6- Absorber
questions.solution_en:
First 3 letters of each word are same.

4th letter of Absurdly, Abstriction, Abstract, Absolutely, Abstain, and Absorber are 'u', 't', 't', 'o', 't', and 'o' respectively.

5th letter of Abstriction, Abstract, and Abstain are 'r', 'r', and 'a' respectively while 6th letter of Abstriction and Abstract are 'i' and 'a' respectively.

5th letter of Absolutely and Absorber are 'l' and 'r' respectively.

So, 1st word = Absolutely

2nd word = Absorber

3rd word = Abstain

4th word = Abstract

5th word = Abstriction

6th word = Absurdly

Hence, correct order is: 4, 6, 5, 3, 2, 1.

questions.q_en: In a class, the rank of Ajju is 9th from the top and the rank of Gajju is 21st from the last. If the ranks of Ajju and Gajju are interchanged, then Gajju will be 30th from the last. How many students are there is the class?
questions.solution_en:
In a class, the rank of Ajju is 9th from the top and the rank of Gajju is 21st from the last.

8 students > Ajju (9th from top) > 'n' number of students > Gajju (21st from last) - 20 students.

If the ranks of Ajju and Gajju are interchanged, then Gajju will be 30th from the last.

8 students > Gajju (30th from last) > 29 students.

So, total students = 8 students + 30 students = 38 students.
